facts: HardwareEvidenceCollector holds the canonical exclusive lease across registered binding, observe_inventory and eligible validate_required calls for four GPUs.

ProtectedHardwareLatch writes only when state changes. Each changed proof write executes root_payload_guard before and after protected JSON persistence. Four newly changed healthy GPU proofs imply eight full scans; this is a source-derived count, not an observed LIVE05 count. Inventory transitions can add writes.

root_payload_guard verifies registration then recursively os.walks eligible root-device trees including /opt and /var/lib, checking each eligible file. Registered data/model mounts and symlinks are excluded; /etc is not a scan candidate.
This is an avoidable periodic critical-section bottleneck and plausible contention source, not measured historical timing.

Observer marks an overdue sample timeout and retains its live worker; it does not interrupt the callback or release its canonical lease.
